name: Estrella fósil en la Mezquita de Córdoba
description: Incrustada en la fachada oeste de la Mezquita-Catedral de Córdoba, cerca de la calle Torrijos y bajo la Puerta del Sabat, se encuentra la "Estrella de los Deseos", un popular punto de interés que, según la leyenda local, concede un anhelo a quien frote su superficie con el corazón sincero. Aunque el folclore la envuelve en magia, la ciencia revela que se trata en realidad del resto fosilizado de un Clypeaster, un tipo de erizo de mar prehistórico que habitó la región durante el Mioceno. Su presencia en el templo es el resultado natural del uso de piedra calcarenita extraída de canteras locales en la Sierra de Córdoba, un material que solía albergar abundante vida marina prehistórica y que hoy adorna los muros históricos de la ciudad. Anyways this model features a custom 4runner texture I made, a Tahoe by @ImperialBlue, Vintage LFE and Econolite Bullseye Signals, a gas station made by @imin96, a electric tower done by @gisexpert, a traffic control box by Prince Obrymec, Urban background cars by zairiq-123, some apartments by @Comicaroid and what would this intersection be without polycarbonate Peek Signals? LA uses them a lot so it wouldn't be right without them. I'm not sure why, but I love LA, will never be sure why. Hope you find a great use for this model, because idk what I'm even gonna do with this. Maybe some drifting animation but again I don't know. Lastly, thank you @signalrenders for the awsome signal renders. See you next model!

description:
The Antarctic seal is a large marine mammal that inhabits the icy waters surrounding Antarctica. It has a thick layer of blubber and dense fur that help it survive the extreme cold. These seals are strong and agile swimmers, capable of diving to great depths to find food such as fish, squid, and krill. They spend much of their time in the ocean but come onto the ice to rest, breed, and care for their young. Well adapted to their harsh environment, Antarctic seals play an important role in the polar ecosystem.

This 3D model was realized by Clarissa Bignoli and Erika Del Bene during the Universal Civil Service (SCU) at UniGe.

name: Esqueleto ballena jorobada joven 🐋
description:
La ballena jorobada (megaptera novaeangliae) es un cetáceo migratorio conocido por sus largas aletas pectorales y espectaculares saltos. Los adultos miden 12-16 m y pesan 25-40 toneladas. Esta especie se alimenta de krill y peces usando técnicas como redes de burbujas. Cada año migra desde aguas polares a zonas tropicales como el Pacífico colombiano (julio-noviembre), donde los juveniles suelen acercarse a la costa. En la exhibición permanente de biología  se conserva el esqueleto de un ejemplar juvenil de aproximadamente 18 metros, casi completo; aunque carece del coxis una pequeña estructura vestigial que recuerda su ascendencia mamífera y terrestre, permite admirar su colosal anatomía y comprender mejor su adaptación a la vida marina.

name: Lariosaurus valceresii
description: *Lariosaurus valceresii* it's a sauropterygian, belonging to the clade Nothosauroidea. Specimens ascribed to this species come from the Kalkschieferzone, the upper member of the Meride Limestone, cropping out between Valceresio (Varese-Italy) and the Meride area (Canton Ticino - Switzedand), dated to the uppermost Ladinian (~239 MA). This sculpt is based on the holotype specimen, published and illustrated by [Tintori and Renesto (1990)](http://www.researchgate.net/publication/285483807_A_new_Lariosaurus_from_the_Kalkschieferzone_Uppermost_Ladinian_of_Valceresio_Varese_N_Italy).

name: Los catorce apóstoles de Jorge Oteiza, Arantzazu
description:
El Friso de los Apóstoles: Es el elemento más destacado. Consta de catorce figuras de Apóstoles (no doce) alineadas a lo largo del friso, talladas en piedra caliza gris de Markina.

El Vacío: La clave de su significado es el hueco interior que el artista deja en las figuras. Oteiza buscaba representar la idea de que el apóstol (y el cristiano) debe "vaciarse de sí mismo" para poder llenarse de Dios y entregarse a los demás.

Los 14 Apóstoles: Los dos apóstoles de los extremos miran hacia el centro, simbolizando a los nuevos cristianos que se unen a la comunidad por la predicación, aumentando el número de creyentes.

La Piedad: Ubicada en la parte superior del friso, representa a Cristo muerto en los brazos de la Virgen.

Al igual que los apóstoles, las figuras de la Piedad también presentan el vacío en la zona del pecho, especialmente en la Virgen, simbolizando el dolor de la pérdida.

name: Cabaña de Culrueba
description:
Model 3D de la Cabaña de Culrueba, un magnífic exemple de l'arquitectura vernacla i tradicional del paisatge aragonès.

Context Històric i Cultural
Aquest tipus de construccions rurals estan estretament lligades a la història agrícola i ramadera d'Aragó. Històricament, aquestes cabanyes (sovint erigides mitjançant la tècnica mil·lenària de la pedra en sec) eren vitals per a la supervivència rural. Servien com a refugi temporal per als pastors durant les llargues jornades de transhumància, protegint-los de les inclemències del temps, i com a espai per emmagatzemar eines. Aquestes estructures reflecteixen una època on l'aprofitament dels recursos naturals locals era essencial, integrant-se harmònicament en l'entorn natural.

Detalls Tècnics
Aquest model busca digitalitzar i preservar el patrimoni arquitectònic mitjançant fotogrametria d'alta resolució:

Captura d'imatges: Dron DJI Mini 4 Pro.

Processament i Renderitzat: Software Agisoft Metashape.

name: Vivienda con drenaje, Campa Torres
description:
Vivienda de grandes dimensiones situada en la explanada central de la campa Torres y que conserva la canalización de drenaje. Pertenece al período romano.
El Cabo Torres se localiza entre la desembocadura de la Ría de Aboño y la ensenada de el Musel. Es un excelente mirador desde donde se pueden contemplar unas vistas increíbles del Cantábrico, los acantilados, el puerto de El Musel, toda la zona occidental de la ciudad de Gijón y las playas del Concejo de Carreño.

Aquí se encuentra el Parque Arqueológico Natural de la Campa Torres (museo arqueológico al aire libre en el que ver los restos del castro y poblado prerromano) y el Faro de Cabo Torres (acondicionado como zona museística).

The distribution of vegetation of follows the same terrain and drainage, and it shows higher growth where there is moisture. There are other factors, such as soil depth, erosion, and terrain, that affect the landscapes as well.

name: Sabil
description:
This 3D model presents an AI-generated reconstruction of a historic Sabil-Kuttab from Islamic Cairo architecture. The project explores the potential of artificial intelligence and modern 3D technologies in documenting and preserving cultural heritage sites digitally.
The structure combines two traditional functions:
Sabil: a public water dispensary located on the ground level.
Kuttab: an upper space historically used for teaching and Qur’anic education.
The model highlights key architectural elements characteristic of Mamluk and Ottoman Cairo, including:
decorative stone façades,
pointed arches,
carved geometric details,
mashrabiya-inspired wooden elements,
and the elevated wooden pavilion overlooking the street.
This reconstruction serves as an experimental step toward integrating AI-assisted workflows into heritage visualization, virtual tourism, and digital preservation of Islamic monuments

JJJ did all the sculpting and texture work, I added the bones and made it fully useable for MMD and other programs.

name: Brain of Gray Short-tailed Opossum
description:
The gray short-tailed opossum (*Monodelphis domestica*) is a small South American member of the family Didelphidae. Even though it is a marsupial species, the opossum does not have a true pouch. The gray short-tailed opossum is found generally south of the Amazon River, in southern, central, and western Brazil. The species is nocturnal and eats rodents, frogs, reptiles and invertebrates. *Monodelphis domestica* is used as a research model in science.

This 3D model is part of a project that aims to compare the structure of the brains of different vertebrate groups and, therefore, facilitate the study of their neuroanatomy.

description:
Total panic on Rue de la Boulangerie!
Just an ordinary Tuesday morning in Paris... until two bikers decide to turn the street into a Grand Prix circuit. 🏁
At the handlebars: a tiger in a racing suit, closely pursued by a fox who seems to have forgotten he’s a fox. And to complicate matters, a lion is acting as co-pilot... because, apparently, a seatbelt was just too conventional. 😂
Meanwhile, Parisians watch the spectacle from the sidewalks:
— "Help!"
— "But it’s aperitif time!"
— "Did anyone think to call the police?"
— "No, but the bakery is still open!"
A 2CV bravely tries to survive the chaos; the motorbikes are smoking, flames are shooting out, and even the pigeons have asked to relocate to a different neighborhood.
The most worrying part?
The sign says "Street Café"...
With this crew, you realize the coffee comes with comprehensive insurance and—most likely—a fire extinguisher. ☕🔥🤣

name: Applike
description:
Small Roman appliqué in the form of a lion, 3.6 cm high. The animal is rendered in a compact and strongly modelled style. The head dominates the composition, with a prominent muzzle, open mouth and small projecting ears. The mane is indicated by irregular raised strands and incised details. Below the head, the body is represented in a simplified, somewhat schematic manner, with the limbs only partly defined.

The expressive but abbreviated modelling is characteristic of small Roman decorative fittings. Such lion-shaped appliqués may have been attached to boxes, furniture, vessels or other objects. In Roman imagery, the lion was a common symbol associated with strength, power and protection. The original function cannot be determined more precisely without information about the reverse and any surviving attachment device. Bronze; H 3,6 cm.

Model: © Landessammlungen Niederösterreich, Niederösterreich 3D

name: Indian grey mongoose
description:
3D scan of the skull of a Indian grey mongoose (*Herpestes edwardsii*).


The Indian grey mongoose is a mongoose species native to the Indian subcontinent and West Asia. It inhabits open forests, scrublands and cultivated fields, often close to human habitation. It lives in burrows, hedgerows and thickets, among groves of trees, and takes shelter under rocks or bushes and even in drains. It has a body length of 36–45 cm and a tail length of 45 cm where males are significantly larger than the females. Its prey includes rodents, snakes, birds’ eggs and hatchlings, lizards and a variety of invertebrates.

Specimen: Indian grey mongoose, *Herpestes edwardsii *(É. Geoffroy Saint-Hilaire, 1818)

Inventory number: C 1253

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa 

Find out more about the Museum at https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/

name: ARACHNEIA
description:
ARACHNEIA – personal creature design project
Arachneia was born from the idea of a being caught between worlds. Part human, part arachnid, shaped by organic metal and bioluminescent veins. Her design plays with contrasts: soft deep-sea tones against sharp chrome limbs, cosmic textures against smooth anatomy.
I wanted her to feel like a guardian from a forgotten dimension something beautiful, dangerous, and strangely weightless. The carapace carries hints of decay, while the thread-like structures around her act more like energy than silk. Every element is meant to show that tension between elegance and threat, evolution and machinery.
This project let me push my sculpting, texturing, and lighting into a more surreal direction, blending organic forms with biomech silhouettes.

name: Brain of the Tiger Shark
description: Belonging to the order **Carcharhiniformes** (ground sharks) and the family **Galeocerdonidae** (tiger sharks), *Galeocerdo cuvier* (Péron & Lesueur, 1822) is a large, solitary predator found in tropical and subtropical waters, especially around islands and coastal areas. It gets its name from the dark vertical stripes on its body, resembling a tiger’s pattern. This fish is an opportunistic carnivore, consuming a wide range of prey, earning it the nickname "garbage can of the sea" and they can reach up to 7.5 meters in length and weigh over 3,000 kg. Though typically found in shallow waters, they can dive to depths of 350 meters and occasionally venture into the open ocean. This species is ovoviviparous, giving birth to up to 80 pups per litter. It has highly developed senses, including an acute sense of smell and electroreception. Despite its ecological importance, the tiger shark faces significant threats from overfishing, habitat loss, and the shark fin trade.

name: Dugong (scale model)
description:
3D scan of the scale model (22 cm) of a dugong (*Dugong dugon*). 

This resin model was created by [Naturaliter Srl](https://www.naturaliter.com/) for the permanent exhibition Not Only Cetaceans. Complementing the exhibition dedicated to marine mammals, this display focuses on animals that have adapted to life in the water through evolutionary pathways different from those of dolphins and whales. The exhibition features sirenians (dugongs and manatees), pinnipeds (sea lions, seals, and walruses), and the polar bear. On display are complete skeletons and skulls from the Museum’s historical collections, as well as scale and life-size models and casts of both extant and extinct species. The scale models were specifically designed to be tactile, enabling visually impaired and blind people, to explore and understand the shapes and proportions of these animals and their fossil ancestors.

Specimen: Dugong, *Dugong dugon* (Müller, 1776)

Scanned and edited by Simone Farina

name: Bison
description:
A bison  is a large bovine in the genus Bison
The American and eropean bison are among the largest surviving terrestrial animals in North America and Europe. They are typical artiodactyl (cloven hooved) ungulates, and are similar in appearance to other bovines. They are broad and muscular with shaggy coats of long hair. Adults grow up to 2 metres  in height and 3.5 m  in length for American bison
Bison are nomadic grazers and travel in herds. The bulls leave the herds of females at two or three years of age, and join a herd of males, which usually are smaller than female herds. 

Bison were a significant resource for Indigenous peoples of North America for food and raw materials until near extinction in the late 19th century.

Owing to their size, bison have few predators. Five exceptions are humans, grey wolves, cougars, grizzly bears, and coyotes. Wolves generally take down a bison while in a pack, .Grizzly bears also consume bison, often by driving off the pack and consuming the wolves' kill.

name: Ashen Blight Queen
description:
At the heart of every *Beetle Rubigenum* Colony is the Queen. Almost spider-like in appearance, the Queen's sole purpose is to manage the hive and birth new workers and/or soldiers. 

The *Ashen Blight Queen* is an extremely toxic variant living within it's hive, most often located inside volcanoes, active or inactive. However - unlike it's sister variant, the Fireborne Blight Queen - this one has evolved to make greater use of it's sulfuric surroundings rather than the firey heat itself. When attacked or threatened, it will emit thick clouds of gas (composed mainly of sulfur dioxide) as a defense mechanism, oftentimes filling it's entire chamber with the fumes.

**Other Things to Note:** *Do not engage without wearing a face covering.*

This asset contains 13 animations including Idle, Combat, and Walk animations, as well as two special animations specific to this variant.
(**Spray Fumes, Fume Sweep Attack**)

Modeled, retopologized, rigged and animated in Blender. Textured in Quixel Mixer.

name: the Muru / el muru (made in paint 3d)
description:
In the oral traditions of Chile’s coastal regions, particularly among Mapuche communities, there exists a long-whispered legend of ghostly beings that walk the shores before and during catastrophes. These entities had no formal name for centuries - only described in fragments and murmurs passed from survivor to survivor.

It wasn’t until the 27F Earthquake in 2010 that a term gained traction: “Muru”, a word meaning complaint or warning in Mapudungun. Survivors, particularly in Talcahuano, Dichato, and Curanilahue, began using this term to refer to the strange, faceless entities seen walking in the waves before the tsunami struck.

name: Dimorphodon
description:
**game: Carnivores 1 / 2**
Dimorphodon is an ambient animal in Carnivores, Carnivores 2, and Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunter.

**reality**

Dimorphodon (from the Greek di, "two," morphe, "form," and odon, "tooth"; "two-formed teeth") is a genus of rhamphorhynchoid pterosaurs from the Early Jurassic, 195 to 190 million years ago. It was named by paleontologist Richard Owen in 1859.

Dimorphodon had a wingspan of approximately 1.4 m and a length of 1 m, including the tail. It had a large, bulky skull, the weight of which was reduced by the presence of large cavities separated by thin bony walls. This structure, reminiscent of the arches of a bridge, led Owen to assert that no other vertebrate had achieved such weight efficiency in its skeletal structure.

description:
The Living Nest is a community library located at 5 Fleet Street, North Parramatta. Inspired by the birdhouses discovered during the site visit, the project explores how architecture can return space to nature rather than continue to displace it.

The library is conceived as a shared habitat—a living nest where people, community, landscape and wildlife can coexist. Timber, vegetation, natural light and open circulation blur the boundary between inside and outside, allowing the surrounding parkland to extend into the building.

A continuous ramp forms the main architectural journey, connecting reading areas, exhibition spaces, community spaces, planted terraces and the walkable green roof. As visitors gradually move upward, they encounter books, activities, sunlight and landscape, creating an experience similar to walking through a forest.

Rather than simply storing books, The Living Nest becomes a place where knowledge, nature, memory and community can meet, grow and live together.

name: Hixon House Basement and Archaeology
description:
Partial scan of the basement of the Historic Gideon Hixon House in La Crosse, WI. (https://www.lchshistory.org/hixon-house)  The scan includes Trench N198 from archaeological investigations to the north of the house conducted by the Department of Archaeology and Anthropology, University of Wisconsin-La Crosse. This scan is only a preliminary, partial scan created for the purpose of exploring the three-dimensional relationshiips between the archaeological remains outside and the interior cistern and piping in the basement.

Created from 1692 photographs (Canon EOS Rebel T8i with Godox AR400 light ring. The scanning was conducted in three parts:1) largest portion of basement including internal cistern area, 2) internal cistern area, first room, and bulkhead entrance stairs with surrounding outside ground, and 3) outside archaeological trench in Metashape 2.1.3.  Scans were the compiled, cleaned up and cropped as well as presumed exterior piping added in Blender 5.1.

Photographed in June 15, 16, and 26, 2026.

name: Circuit Gilles Villeneuve Montreal 2019 layout
description:
The Circuit Gilles Villeneuve, also spelled Circuit Gilles-Villeneuve, is a 4.361 km (2.710 mi) motor racing circuit on Notre Dame Island in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. It is the venue for the FIA Formula One Canadian Grand Prix. It has previously hosted the World Sportscar Championship, the Champ Car World Series (Grand Prix of Montreal), the NASCAR Pinty’s Series, the NASCAR Nationwide Series (NAPA Auto Parts 200), and the Grand-Am Rolex Sports Car Series.

The Canadian Grand Prix was first held at the circuit in 1978, where hometown hero Gilles Villeneuve (1950–1982) won for Scuderia Ferrari. The Grand Prix quickly became a mainstay of the Formula One calendar, with the race taking place in Montreal for the next thirty years. Once held in late September, the event was moved to its present location on the calendar of mid-June in 1982, to provide a warmer, more pleasant race weekend.

name: Austin Circuit of the Americas 2012 layout
description:
The Circuit of the Americas (COTA) is a Grade 1 FIA-specification 3.426-mile (5.514 km) motor racing track and facilities located in Austin, Texas, United States. The facility is home to the Formula One United States Grand Prix, NASCAR, and the Motorcycle Grand Prix of the Americas, a round in MotoGP and the FIA World Endurance Championship with the Lone Star Le Mans. It previously hosted the Australian V8 Supercars, the Americas Rallycross Championship, the American Le Mans Series, the Rolex Sports Car Series, the IMSA SportsCar Championship and the IndyCar Classic.

The circuit and Grand Prix were first proposed in the middle of 2010. The circuit was the first in the United States to be purpose-built for Formula One. The layout was conceived by promoter Tavo Hellmund and 1993 Motorcycle World Champion Kevin Schwantz with the assistance of German architect and circuit designer Hermann Tilke.

name: Zürich, Glockenhof
description:
ING PLUS erfasste den historischen Glockenhof mittels 3D-Laserscanning und erstellte einen digitalen Zwilling als Grundlage für die geplante Sanierung und Umbauplanung.
Für die geplante Sanierung des historischen Glockenhofs in Zürich führte ING PLUS eine umfassende Gebäudeaufnahme mittels modernem 3D-Laserscanning durch. Das prägende Gebäudeensemble im Herzen der Stadt wurde über zehn Geschosse auf einer Fläche von rund 10'000 m² vollständig digital erfasst.
Auf Basis der aufgenommenen 3D-Punktwolke entstand in ArchiCAD ein präziser digitaler Zwilling des Bestands. Während die Innenbereiche im Level of Detail 1:50 modelliert wurden, erfolgte die Auswertung der schützenswerten Fassaden aufgrund ihrer architektonischen Bedeutung im Level of Detail 1:20.
Der Glockenhof zählt zu den markanten historischen Gebäuden Zürichs und verbindet denkmalgeschützte Bausubstanz mit einer vielseitigen Nutzung.

description:
**Electric Vehicle Chassis with Differential Gear**

A detailed 3D model of an electric vehicle (EV) chassis and drivetrain assembly, designed to demonstrate the major mechanical components involved in electric propulsion.

The model features a central electric motor connected to a differential gear mechanism, which distributes torque to the driven wheels while allowing them to rotate at different speeds during cornering. The chassis also includes the battery pack, motor assembly, drivetrain components, suspension elements, wheels, and structural frame.

This model is suitable for automotive engineering visualization, EV drivetrain studies, mechanical design demonstrations, educational projects, and 3D presentations.

**Note:** *The differential allows the left and right driven wheels to rotate at different speeds, improving vehicle stability and reducing tire slip while turning.*

name: Reconstruction of the acropolis (Nižná Myšľa).
description:
Documentation project of the open-air museum in Nižná Myšľa, Slovakia.

The museum reconstructs a fortified Bronze Age settlement associated with the Otomani culture, dated to approximately 1700–1400 BCE. The site features a recreated acropolis along with selected residential and utility buildings, offering a glimpse into the daily life of this prehistoric community.

This simplified model (due to Skechfab limits) was created as part of a photogrammetric documentation project. Data was collected using both drone-based aerial photography and ground-based camera capture. The final model was processed in Reality Capture.

name: Arco de Mazarelos. Santiago de Compostela
description:
El Arco de Mazarelos, ubicado en la ciudad de Santiago de Compostela, es una de las estructuras más emblemáticas de su casco histórico. Se trata del único arco que aún se conserva de la muralla medieval que protegía la ciudad, y su diseño evoca la rica historia y el legado cultural de Santiago.

Descripción arquitectónica y artística:

Estilo arquitectónico: El arco presenta un diseño sencillo pero imponente, característico de las fortificaciones medievales gallegas. Construido principalmente en piedra, destaca por su robustez y la elegancia de sus proporciones.

Estructura: Es un arco de medio punto formado por grandes bloques de granito, que son típicos de la región.

Dimensiones: Aunque de tamaño moderado, la amplitud del arco permite que sea un paso significativo tanto para peatones como para vehículos ligeros.

name: Rathfran Abbey Cross-Slab (MA015-031007-)
description: Cross-slab grave-cover located in the north-east corner of Rathfran (Ráth Bhrannaibh) Dominican Friary church (MA015-031005-), County Mayo.  Now standing upright where it has been secured to the internal face of the eastern gable, on the northern side of the window embrasure. A tapering trapezoidal-shaped chamfered cross-slab grave cover measuring 6 ft. 4in (1.93m) long by 2ft. (0.6m) top width x 1ft. 6in. (0.45m) base width.  The slab is decorated with a ringed-cross with expanded terminals. A quarternary knot/four-cornered interlaced knot is visible in the top left corner. Flanking the shaft there is an inscription carved in false relief: the Latin inscription extending in two vertical lines, reads: IOHANNES O MMNILANIE FIERI FECIT 1618 (possible translation - John O'Munnelly? had me made in 1618). Archaeological Survey of Ireland, description accessible: https://tinyurl.com/48dnsezd

name: Taburete Bamileke
description:
En el alfeizar de una ventana de la habitación [África](http://www.rutadeltiempo.es/habitaciones/africa/) de **Ruta del Tiempo**  está este taburete de pedestal, fabricado en madera. 
Procede de los **Bamileke**, nombre que aglutina 107 comunidades del grupo étnico Semi-Bantu (Camerún). Cada una de ellas está dirigida por un jefe (*fô* o *fon*) con una legitimidad ritual, manteniendo una institución tradicional que regula la vida de la comunidad.
El nombre *Bamileke* surge de la época colonial, cuando los alemanes oyeron identificarse a la gente de Foto “Mbá Me Leke” y “Pe Me Leke” en lengua Yema, que significa “la casa de la gente de las montañas” y “los habitantes de las montañas”.
La escultura en madera es una de sus formas de arte más relevante, y en la jerarquizada sociedad los escultores tienen un papel de prestigio. Este taburete aúna función y estética, estando la parte superior decorada con elefantes, serpientes, ¿pipas? y ¿calabazas? que surgen de un nudo entrelazado central

name: Loka_04_Mahar_SriYantra | PAPP
description:
Mahar Sri Yantra V2 is a high-relief disc from the PAPP Loka Series, encoding the Plane of Light through the geometry of the Sri Yantra. 
The object is built from a PAPP seed passed through the full 6-stage pipeline (φ-convergent renormalization, continued fraction projection, Pythagorean generation, 4D S³ construction, Hopf fibration, and stereographic projection), then fused with the classical 9 interlocking triangles of the yantra. 
In V2, the hierarchy is pushed into sculptural relief: a dominant central bindu, elevated Shiva and Shakti triangle ridges, Trivalaya rings, lotus zones, and Bhupura framing, separated by deep shadow cavities. 
The mesh is a closed orientable manifold with 57,170 vertices, 114,336 faces, and Euler characteristic χ=2, designed as a dense ceremonial object where sacred geometry reads as architecture rather than flat diagram.

구룡사는 신라 문무왕 8년(668년)에 의상대사가 창건한 사찰로 대웅전 자리에 9마리의 용이 살고 있는 연못을 메우고 사찰을 창건하여 구룡사(九龍寺)라 하였으나, 조선 중기에 거북바위 설화와 관련하여 현재의 명칭인 구룡사(龜龍寺)로 개칭하였다고 전해진다.

사천왕문은 정면 3칸, 측면 2칸의 겹처마에 팔작지붕을 한 중층 누각의 규모가 큰 건물이다.

내부는 중앙 어칸에 통로를 내고, 좌우 협칸에는 수미산 중턱에 있다는 동서남북 제 개의 하늘, 즉 사왕천을 다스리면서 불법과 가람을 지키는 거대한 목조 사천왕상이 배치되어 있다.

사천왕은 동쪽에 지국천왕, 남쪽에 증장천왕, 서쪽에 광목천왕, 북쪽에 다문천왕을 말하는데 경내로 침입하는 사악한 무리들을 물리치기 위해 우람한 체격에 험상궂은 표정을 하고 있다.

name: San Gil Church, Atienza
description:
**Description**: The medieval church of San Gil (Atienza, Spain) was built in the Middle Ages (12th century), after the Christian conquest of this territory. This is a beautiful example of the Romanesque style although in the 16th century the church underwent a major extension to increase its capacity. Inside the church, two capitals decorated with human heads stand out (one head represents good and the other evil). The main portal of the church was built in Plateresque style. It currently houses the Atienza Museum of Religious Art.

**Methodology**: 3D model made in Reality Capture using 127 Leica RTC360 scan positions and 5029 terrestrial and drone-based images. Additional processing completed in Geomagic Wrap.

**Acknowledgment**: We want to thank the collaboration of the Bishopric of Sigüenza-Guadalajara, especially D. Julián García Sánchez and D. Miguel Ángel Ortega Canales, for the facilities they have given us and for the interest they have shown in the project.

name: Vaso de Ciempozuelos
description:
Vaso campaniforme cerámico elaborado a mano, con boca de embudo, cuello marcado y cuerpo globular. La pasta es negra y la superficie está bruñida con decoración geométrica incisa de surcos finos y profundos.
Fue realizado a finales del tercer milenio a. C. en el Bronce Inicial de la península ibérica.

Hand-made ceramic bell-shaped vessel, with a funnel mouth, marked neck and globular body. The paste is black and the surface is burnished with incised geometric decoration of fine, deep grooves.
It was made at the end of the third millennium BC. C. in the Early Bronze Age of the Iberian Peninsula.

name: Sistema de Escape
description:
Este modelo 3D representa el conjunto ensamblado del sistema de escape de un motor Suzuki RMX 50. El objetivo es mostrar de forma fiel la disposición y relación funcional de los distintos componentes que intervienen en la evacuación de gases y en el rendimiento del motor.

El conjunto incluye la cámara de expansión, el manguito de unión, el silencioso y los elementos de fijación asociados, permitiendo comprender tanto el recorrido de los gases como la función de cada tramo dentro del sistema. Todas las piezas han sido modeladas y ensambladas respetando su geometría y funcionamiento real.

Este modelo forma parte de un proyecto de ingeniería orientado a la visualización técnica mediante modelos 3D interactivos y documentación asociada, facilitando la comprensión del comportamiento de los sistemas de escape en motores de dos tiempos.

name: Four-cylinder engine block
description:
Get up close with this ultra-detailed 4-cylinder engine block, captured with Artec Point 3D laser scanner. This 3D model of a rectangular engine block digitally recreates each cylinder, with every hollow and rib accurately rendered. Scanned only in upright position, the model includes the clearly defined cylinder head, a combustion chamber, valve seats, ports, and a water jacket. Beneath the cylinders, examine the crankshaft, connecting rods, and the oil pan – even the digits of the serial number are clearly visible.

Our workflow began with a 10-minute prep, followed by a rapid 30-minute scan using Artec Point. With a 120 FPS capture rate, layers of intricate gears were captured with exceptional speed and clarity. Another 20 minutes of processing in Artec Studio produced a neat 3D model with 0.02 mm accuracy, exceptional for quality control and reverse engineering.

Scanning time: 30 minutes | Processing time: 20 minutes

name: (PSX) Chevrolet Camaro SS
description:
The Camaro is a pony car produced by GM and sold by Chevrolet for six generations since 1966. It was conceived as a “small, vicious animal that eats Mustangs” and replacement for the Corvair Monza, mostly but not exclusively because of a certain “consumer activist” tarnishing its name with a single book.

The sixth-gen Camaro is the successor of the revived fifth-gen Camaro, based on a Cadillac platform and made in the Lansing plant from 2016 to very recently. The car was also exported outside of North America, to both Europe, and then to Australia by Holden Special Vehicles (yes, *that* HSV).

The SS name has also returned from its predecessor and remains the regular trim model with a V8, this time an LT1 producing 455 in both horsepower and foot pounds (339kW, 617N⋅m). The trim is split into two, the 1SS and the 2SS, the latter offering more bells and whistles.

Modelling work was done on Blender 3.3.1 while texture work was done on Aseprite.

description:
This work is based on a Sketchup-file. Unfortunately I don´t remember the name of its author. Anyway, thanks for the great model! Several years ago I converted and repaired it into a watertight STL-file. Sadly the resolution of the model is only useful for printing in small scales.

My purpose is to provide watertight STL-files for you, which can easily be modified for 3D-printing, according to your references. Therefore, most of my models are not repaired into one single shell. This may be a bit more difficult for the preparation of the build, but helps you a lot, if you want to personalize the model. E.g. if you want to seperate parts, such as wheels or to remove delicate details like wipers etc.

Before printing, please check out if you have to modify the model, depending on the favored size of your print and the requirements of your printer. I hope you enjoy it. Happy printing!

If you are going to print this model, please feel free to share your experiences about its printability in the comments.

name: Dama de Elche decorada
description:
Busto femenino que presenta una dama de rostro con facciones muy perfectas y que conserva restos de policromía en los labios y zonas puntuales de rostro y vestimenta. La dama va ricamente ataviada: en la cabeza lleva un tocado formado por una tiara puntiaguda cubierta por un velo y encima un tirante que une los dos rodetes laterales o "estuches" que enmarcan el rostro, donde iría recogido el peinado y una diadema sobre la frente; la espalda y los hombros se cubren con un manto que forma pliegues en la parte de delante y deja al descubierto tres collares con anforillas y porta-amuletos.

En esta reconstrucción virtual, realizamos una propuesta de la policromía original que tendría el busto en base a las investigaciones de su equipo de conservación por parte del museo arqueológico nacional. La pieza se ha realizado íntegramente mediante modelado 3D, en Blender, Zbrush y las texturas se crearon en substance painter.

name: WW2 Swiss Army M1918/40 Helmet
description:
The M1918 also known as the M18 was a Swiss steel helmet used by the Swiss Armed Forces. Despite the name, M1918, It was first issued to personnel in 1924. It was designed by Dr. Edward A. Gessler and Paul Boesh, it was inspired by the german M1916 Helmet. it had 3 different variants, that being the M18, M18/40, And the M18/43. The M18/40 has a shorter skirt, the M18/43 was painted black textured with sawdust and was fitted a new liner.  It never saw combat and was phased out sometime in late 20th century with around 600,000 units made.

name: 州浜菊花双鳥鏡　Chrysanthemum mirror with paired birds
description:
◯真岡市市ノ塚遺跡　Ichinozuka Site　Moka City, Tochigi Prefecture, JAPAN　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　◯鎌倉時代（13世紀）Kamakurai period (13th century)　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　◯径さ11.5ｃｍ　　　11.5cm in diameter　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　◯三次元計測：栃木県埋蔵文化財センター　計測機材：Next Engine HD Pro　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　◯文献：とちぎ生涯学習文化財団2008『市ノ塚遺跡』

Mirrors were introduced to Japan from China during the Yayoi period in the second century BCE. Initially, imported mirrors and locally produced copies of Chinese examples were used. By the late eleventh century, during the Heian period, mirrors of a distinctly Japanese style, known as wakyo (Japanese mirrors), began to be produced. The wakyo shown here is decorated on its reverse side with a suhama motif, a stylized shoreline, in the lower portion. Rising from the right side of the shoreline is a chrysanthemum plant whose blossoms fill much of the upper half of the design. To the left is a waterside plant, possibly a rabbit-ear iris (kakitsubata), and above it appears a pair of birds facing one another.

description:
Modello 3D dell'Obelisco della Spedizione di Crimea, monumento situato in Piazza Crimea nel quartiere Borgo Crimea di Torino.
Il monumento fu realizzato nel 1888 dallo scultore Luigi Belli per commemorare la partecipazione del Piemonte alla Guerra di Crimea (1855), episodio fondamentale nel processo di unificazione italiana.
Il modello è stato acquisito tramite fotogrammetria image-based, utilizzando una serie di fotografie scattate attorno al monumento ed elaborate con Agisoft Metashape per la generazione della nuvola di punti, della mesh e della texture. name: Anchor Church Caves, Derbyshire - Merged
description:
Anchor Church is a series of caves in a Keuper Sandstone (Triassic conglomerate) outcrop, close to the village of Ingleby, Derbyshire, England. The caves have been extended by human intervention to form a crude dwelling place, complete with door and window holes.

The sandstone outcrop once formed part of the banks of the River Trent and the caves were formed by the action of the river on the rock. The course of the river has altered and left the caves opening onto a backwater pool. It has been designated as both a Regionally Important Geological Site, and as a Local Wildlife Site

Created in RealityScan by Epic Games from 122 images in 00h:21m:25s.

Sudbury Digital Imaging is working with Staffordshire Wildlife Trust on the Trent Valley Past and Present project, helping to connect communities with their heritage. (https://www.thetrentvalley.org.uk/projects/tvpp/)

name: Stele Giustiniani (c.460 BCE)
description:
The so-called Stele Giustiniani is one of the most affecting funerary monuments from early Classical Greece. Carved in Parian marble around 460 BCE, it shows a young girl in a quiet, inward-looking moment, standing with lowered head as she reaches into a small round box. Rather than presenting death dramatically, the relief turns stillness itself into memory. The work is celebrated for its refinement, its remarkable state of preservation, and its ability to convey grief through restraint rather than overt emotion. 

View Artifact: https://thevimu.com/stele-giustiniani-c-460-bce/

name: María Stma. del Rocío Vélez-Málaga
description:
Reproducción 3D basada en escaneo de **María Stma. del Rocío**. En el formato Busto.

El día 29 de abril de 1980 se reúne la Junta directiva en unión de los hermanos de la Cofradia. Se encarga la Imagen de Maria Santísima del Rocío con el fin de ser posesionada el domingo de ramos junto con “La Pollinica”.

La imagen es obra del Imaginero Sevillano Don Juan Ventura y fue bendecida el día 10 de mayo de 1980 en la iglesia de nuestra Señora de Gracia “las Claras” por el párroco de la misma, Don Jose Fenoy.
Se procesiona por primera vez El Domingo de Ramos 12 de abril de 1981.

Modelo tridimensional generado a partir de escaneos de alta precisión, procesado y adaptado por Antonio Delgado. Para su reproducción en escalas reducidas se han introducido ajustes en proporciones y espesores. El archivo mostrado en esta plataforma corresponde a una versión de baja resolución optimizada para su visualización, y no refleja la calidad completa del modelo original. This 3D model is a high-precision reality capture representation of Seongsan Ilchulbong, a tuff cone formed by underwater volcanic eruptions approximately 5,000 years ago.

🔍 Key Features:
- Photogrammetry-based realistic 3D model
- Millimeter-accurate terrain reproduction
- Precise distance/area measurement capabilities
- Viewshed and shadow analysis support
- Real-time data visualization overlay compatibility

This model enables detailed observation of the unique crater formation and coastal erosion patterns, serving as valuable data for volcanological research and terrain change monitoring.

name: The Tablet of Shamash

name: Tel Dan Stele
description:
The Tel Dan Stele is a fragmentary stele containing an Aramaic inscription which dates to the 9th century BCE. It is the earliest known extra-biblical archaeological reference to the house of David. The stele was discovered in 1993 in Tel-Dan by Gila Cook, a member of an archaeological team led by Avraham Biran. Its pieces were used to construct an ancient stone wall that survived into modern times. The stele contains several lines of ancient Hebrew. The surviving inscription details that an individual killed Jehoram, King of Israel-Samaria, the son of Ahab, and Ahaziah of Judah, a king of the house of David. The stele is currently on display at the Israel Museumand is known as KAI 310.

name: Roman theatre of Dougga | TUNISIA
description:
Like all the other Roman cities of North Africa from the reign of Augustus, Dougga had its own theatre. According to historians, the monument was built between 168 and 169. It is located in the eastern part of the archeological site Dougga, and can host over 3500 spectators.
The theatre got classified as a monument on 8 June 1891. It is considered as one of the best preserved examples of theatres in Roman Africa
Nowadays, it hosts every year the activities of the Dougga's international festival. 

---------------------------------------------------

El teatro romano de Dougga se encuentra en el yacimiento arqueológico de Dougga en Túnez, fue construido entre el 168 y 168 y es de los mejores conservados en el África romana, podía acoger a 3.500 espectadores, cuando la ciudad contaba con unos 10 000 habitantes, en su periodo de mayor esplendor. Fue construido a costa de Publio Marcius Quadratus. Se compone de una cavea (19 gradas en tres plantas divididas por pasos de circulación), una orquesta y un escenario.

An AMP (Amplifier) then boosts that signal, making the sound louder, clearer, and more powerful—especially useful for headphones that require more power.

The Topping DX7 Pro+ is an all-in-one DAC and amplifier. This means it can take audio from multiple sources (USB, Bluetooth, optical), process it with high precision, and output high-quality sound to your headphones or speakers. It’s well known for delivering a very clean, detailed, and neutral sound.

In short, the DX7 Pro+ is ideal if you want a serious audio upgrade—for music listening, gaming, or production—because it significantly improves clarity and power compared to built-in audio from a PC or phone.

name: Aricept/E2020 Inhibtion of Acetylcholinesterase
description:
Acetylcholinesterase (AChE) is an enzyme that terminates nerve signals by breaking down the neurotransmitter, acetylcholine (ACh), into acetic acid and choline. ACh is that is crucial for muscle movement and cognition. AChE ensures that the signal is brief and controlled for the target cells.

However, E2020, an Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) medication, works by slowing down AChE catalysis via non-covalent competitive inhibition. The lack of cholinergic activity is hypothesised to accelerate neurodegeneration by increasing tau tangle and amyloid plaques accumulation. By inhibiting the ACh breakdown, E2020 prolongs ACh activity in the synapses, enhancing target cell stimulation. The biomolecular model uses AChE of Tetronarce calfornica to depict the key interactions with E2020 which include hydrophobic interactions, π-π stacking, cation-π bonds, and hydrogen bonds.

Scale: The model is just over 400 metres in total length and is ~100 metres wide at the widest point. Orientation of the long axis is approximately east-west (east in the right foreground in initial view).

This version has been reprocessed with Metashape v2.3, which produces much sharper textures.  The original can be viewed [here](https://skfb.ly/onBLu).

name: Medical Skull Model (CT Scan Data)
description:
This is a highly detailed and anatomically precise 3D reconstruction of a human skull, generated directly from authentic medical imaging data (CT and MRI scans). Unlike stylized or manually sculpted models, this asset preserves the organic irregularities and intricate structural features of genuine human anatomy.

The model provides a clear view of the facial skeleton, deep orbital cavities, nasal passages, and the complex interior layout of the cranial base. It has been processed to optimize surface topology while maintaining the high fidelity required for professional use. This digital replica is ideal for medical students, healthcare educators, radiological reference, forensic anthropology studies, and high-quality scientific visualizations. Additionally, the watertight mesh makes it an excellent foundation for 3D printing applications, physical anatomical models, or surgical planning simulations.

name: Sänger Silbervogel (low poly)
description:
The Silbervogel (silver bird) was a design for a liquid-propellant rocket-powered sub-orbital bomber produced by Eugen Sänger and Irene Bredt in the late 1930s for The Third Reich. It is also known as the Raketenbomber (rocket bomber). It was one of a number of designs considered for the Amerikabomber project, which started in the spring of 1942 being focused solely on trans-Atlantic-range piston-engined strategic bombers such as the Messerschmitt Me 264: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/messerschmitt-me-264-low-poly-7ea7f445888e4a00932e78f58f06cd7d  and the Junkers Ju 390:
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/junkers-ju-390b-seefernaufklarer-low-poly-0b57afee26be401dba295521aaf180f4 the only two airframe types which were actually built and flown for the competition. When Walter Dornberger attempted to create interest in military spaceplanes in the United States after World War II he chose the more diplomatic term antipodal bomber. 

I have originaly made it as a part for the "air reskin mod" for Hearts of Iron IV.

High in the sky at very low temperatures tiny crystals of unusual ice grow.  Their shape and lattice resemble those of diamond.

(The man was famous for the invention of the pantograph used for scaling  drawings. He also confimed of existence of dark spots discovered by Galileo on the Sun's surface). 

The halo has been observed only a few times since then. The arcs occure at an angle of 28° from the Sun or Moon

The crystal lattice of the cubic ice is formed of layers of parallel rows of water molecules. The structure looks quite simple. 

The pimitive cell is the one of diamond, where carbon is substituted by oxygen and  in the middle of each bond there is a hydrogen atom.

name: Attack on Mouse Acetylcholinesterase
description:
Fasiculin (Fas) is a family of venoms found in Mambas (Dendroapis) a type of snake, which can inhibit reversibly to fish and mammalian Acetylocholinesterase (AChE) at very low concentrations. The Fas I'm looking at is the Fas2 which specifically binds to mouse AChE (mAChE) and interacts with multiple residues located at the rim of the gorge on mAChE. 

This interaction causes the lack of function from the mAChE therefore inhibiting its activity to hydrolyse the neurotransmitter Acetylcholine (nACh) into choline and acetate. The lack of termination of nACh means there will be a build up causing the nicotinic receptors to be overstimulated, resulting in; paralysis, muscle spasms, convulsions, and potential death due to respiratory failure.

description:
These are the two most important types of cages. The one on the left consists of 20 water molecules and has 12 pentagonal faces. The one on the right consists of 24 molecules and has 12 pentagonal faces and 2 hexagonal faces. Their free volumes are 51 and 77 cubic angstroms, respectively.

In the foreground, you can see connectivity maps. Imagine the molecules are connected by rubber bands. Now, stretch the cage's outermost "window" until the entire structure flattens out.

Unfortunately, this is just an animation, not a simulation. Sketchfab failed to correctly load the simulation data from my Blender file.

I created the models using information from this website: https://vitroid.github.io/water-science/water/clathrate_hydrates.html

name: 3D Printed Steam Methane Reforming Plant
description:
This is a simplified steam methane reforming plant, to go along with its 3D printed counterpart for classroom teaching.

Natural gas first enters a desulfurizer before being mixed with high pressure steam, and is then sent to the convection section of the furnace for preheating. The gas then goes through multiple packed catalyst beds in the main body of the furnace before being sent to a boiler to cool down. The high pressure steam generated by the boiler is sent back to the beginning of the process while the cooled gas enters the water gas shift reactor for further reaction. A neutral sweep gas forces the mostly pure hydrogen into the second boiler which creates low pressure steam, while any retentate is sent to be burned in the furnace. After further cooling, the mostly pure hydrogen enters a two phase seperator to remove condensate before entering the pressure swing adsorber. Waste gas is burned in the furnace while pure hydrogen exits for further use.

name: La_coupole_Helfaut
description:
Située à 5 km de Saint-Omer (dans le Pas-de-Calais), La Coupole est l’un des monuments historiques les plus impressionnants de la Seconde Guerre mondiale en Europe. Première base souterraine allemande de lancement de fusées V2.
Edifiée par l’organisation Todt à partir de l’automne 1943. Le site choisi, à Helfaut, dans le nord de la France, se situe à portée de tir de la 1re fusée, le V2, pour viser Londres. Ce gigantesque bunker souterrain, constitué de centaines de mètres de galeries, est surmonté d’un dôme couvrant la salle de préparation au tir : une demi-sphère en béton armé de 77 mètres de diamètre et de 5,5 mètres d’épaisseur, pesant 55 000 tonnes. Le site n’a jamais été opérationnel, freiné par les bombardements massifs des Alliés puis par le Débarquement en Normandie.
Le site est réhabilité en 1997 en un Centre d’Histoire et de Mémoire. Depuis 2012, il est doté d’un Centre de Ressources et de Recherches ainsi que d’un Planétarium 3D, venant compléter sa partie scientifique.

name: Revolver "Hunger" - FanArt
description:
Recreation, FanArt of the revolver model "Hunger" from the game Witchfire. A big bore six-shot revolver in the dark fantasy style.

It is a game-ready model, tho low poly mesh (without rounds) is about 28k triangles. Mesh could be better and more optimized, but it was done in a very short amount of time and in the "first attempt" as a more or less concept for render. 
The main file, visible in the preview, contains all objects, so revolver as well as live rounds and cartridges and has 4k textures. In the future, I can also add a file with rig and some preview animations.

**The additional file** contains individual meshes in **fbx file format** (like only rounds, or only revolver with live rounds in chambers), along with 4096x4096 8bits textures and lower resolution textures like 2048x2048 8bits, for the front assembly of the revolver, body assembly and bullets (that's why this zip weighs so much).

All modeling was done in Blender, baked in Marmoset Toolbag and textured in Substance Painter.
